title: Construction of the Godement map with prescribed tensor coordinates
statement: For every scheme $X$ there is a family $b(H,K):T(H)\otimes T(K)\to T(H\otimes K)$ satisfying ModuleCupGodementTensorCoordinates [new-module-cup-godement-tensor-coordinates]. Here $T$ is the product of stalk skyscrapers [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model]. No naturality, unit or multiplication law is asserted.

source.place: §1.1.4, Godement resolution tensor construction; Stacks Tag 0FKR

proof.text: For stalk elements choose section representatives and intersect their neighbourhoods. Send the pair to the germ of the sectionwise tensor under tau. If either representative is changed, equality of germs supplies a smaller neighbourhood on which the sections agree; restricting both factors there and using naturality of tau gives the same output. The same common-neighbourhood calculation proves additivity and stalk-ring bilinearity.

For each point x, compose the two skyscraper-projection section maps with this stalk bilinear operation. Over an open U containing x the result is bilinear over O(U), since scalars act through the ring germ; if x is absent all skyscraper sections are zero. Restriction preserves the evaluated coordinates, so tensor universality gives a presheaf map from T(H) tensor T(K) to the skyscraper of (H tensor K)_x. The sheafification adjunction extends it to the sheaf tensor product, uniquely agreeing on pure section tensors. The product universal property assembles these maps into b with the required coordinates. Empty products and zero inputs obey the same universal properties.
